invariants.rule: Todo SQLite is the sole live semantic authority; every mutation is transactional, revisioned, and append-only in event history.
coding-workflow is the only ordinary model-facing workflow protocol; todo-orchestrator is its transactional kernel and maintenance interface.

Local-worker child executions remain bounded subordinates of exactly one active parent claim and are never lanes, roles, run participants, todo owners, communicators, rendezvous participants, or parent completers.

Existing v2 plans, snapshots, lifecycle entities, terminal provenance, child executions, gates, leases, interfaces, decisions, evidence, and historical audit remain readable and functional through forward-only migrations.
Never reset, clean, overwrite, delete, or silently attribute user files, dirty worktrees, commits, patches, or unrelated C4Q state.
Project-control remains a separate stateless read-only observation plane with exactly eight public MCP tools.
cpp-context-compiler, CUDA, and local-coding-worker remain bounded specialized engines; MCP startup performs no GPU, model, repository scan, or benchmark work.
Raw todo, session, child, recovery, GPU, endpoint, packet, log, and transcript secrets never cross the model-facing MCP boundary.

Parallel lanes own disjoint modules and worktrees; shared service, command, schema normalization, projection, registry, and compatibility integration files are owned only by WFU-20 or later release tasks.

barriers.title: All core workflow modules ready for integration

tasks.title: Freeze target architecture and implementation seams

tasks.title: Implement forward-only kernel foundations and fixtures
tasks.objective: Add forward-only database foundations, shared internal service interfaces, capability lineage foundations, normalized semantic contracts, migration fixtures, and the frozen kernel contract consumed by parallel lanes.

tasks.title: Runs, serial lanes, roles, dispatch, and scheduling

tasks.title: Typed messages, cursors, rendezvous, and arrivals

tasks.title: Versioned context fragments and bounded composition
tasks.objective: Implement hashed versioned run, lane, task, decision, delta, and source-reference fragments with targeted invalidation, strict response budgets, and deliberately narrower local-child packets.

tasks.title: Managed isolated workspaces and integration queues
tasks.objective: Implement explicit workspace ownership modes, first-class lane worktree records, immutable patch and commit artifacts, integration queues, base enforcement, conflict preservation, and cleanup eligibility while retaining subordinate child scope leases.

tasks.title: Unified owner recovery engine and administrator command
tasks.objective: Implement one interactive owner-only recovery engine covering first-class dispatches and distinct subordinate child degradation, with live-process refusal, dirty artifact preservation, idempotent terminal reconciliation, audit, and no approval-token round trip.

tasks.title: Canonical workflow service, protocol v2, capabilities, and MCP
tasks.objective: Implement the canonical in-process WorkflowKernel boundary, protocol v2 envelopes, hash-stored lineage-bound first-class capabilities, exact six-tool MCP server, fixed adapters, and compatibility shim without todo subprocess operations.

tasks.title: Harden cross-core authority and concurrency contracts
tasks.objective: After all core lanes arrive, correct cross-module defects found by read-only integration review: authoritative integration-gate provenance, completion-bound rendezvous and canonical barrier composition, workspace reservation/provenance/immutability/final artifact rules, required workspace dispatch validation, child packet source-scope containment, composite fragment ownership, lossless message cursors and resolution deltas, and idempotent synchronization.

tasks.title: Integrate workflow modules into todo services and compatibility surfaces
tasks.objective: Integrate all core modules into shared service methods, CLI commands, schema migration dispatch, plan normalization, export, deterministic snapshots, restore, doctor, audit, projections, semantic reads, and existing lifecycle behavior; publish the normalized semantic read contract.

checkpoints.title: Additive normalized workflow semantic read frozen

tasks.title: Rewrite routing, installer, migration, and operations documentation
tasks.objective: Enforce one front door, add workflow_front_door compatibility policy, reduce the integration path to installer/shim/migration/tests, provide idempotent repository migration, document protocol, lanes versus children, recovery, rollback, and remove obsolete normal-workflow guidance.

tasks.title: Extend project-control additive read model
tasks.objective: In a separate project-control branch/worktree, consume todo's normalized semantic read to display runs, first-class lanes and dispatches, messages, rendezvous, workspaces, patches, recovery, context versions, and subordinate local children separately while preserving exact eight-tool read-only behavior.

tasks.title: Correct completed-program semantic-state selection
tasks.objective: Fix the recorded semantic-state regression so current-only selection retains the most recently completed parent-defined program rather than an unrelated terminal task, while preserving read-only behavior and generic lifecycle filtering.

tasks.title: Harden plan idempotence and canonical protocol integration seams
tasks.objective: Preserve frozen interfaces across plan reapply, complete bounded v2 context and arrival contracts, wire immutable integration requests, and prove canonical kernel behavior before project-control and dogfood validation.
tasks.completion_contract: Repeated plan application preserves terminal interface authority, ordinary protocol envelopes contain bounded safety context, arrival and integration requests are fully validated, and all workflow suites pass.

tasks.title: Remove obsolete protocol discovery and child-independence guidance
tasks.objective: Update the installed two-worker smoke to the exact six-tool protocol and coordinate_task gate action, remove residual wording that describes subordinate local-worker children as independent project work, and add focused regression coverage.
tasks.completion_contract: Every installed discovery example expects exactly six tools, explicit gates use coordinate_task, and local-worker documentation consistently describes nonblocking subordinate child execution.

tasks.title: Complete the frozen workflow semantic read contract
tasks.objective: Expose normalized immutable patch artifacts, synthesize recovery-needed state across authoritative claims, sessions, dispatches, children, gates, locks, resources, workspaces, and integration failures, and emit safe parallel groups only after dependency, interface, lock, resource, and scope checks.
tasks.completion_contract: The additive semantic read satisfies every field promised by WFU-SEMANTIC-READ-V1 without raw-table interpretation in project-control and without overstating parallel safety.

tasks.title: Authorize isolated-merge overlap in claim readiness
tasks.objective: Teach the shared claim/readiness authority to permit overlapping first-class task scopes only when both lanes have explicit isolated_merge contracts, active managed workspaces from the same base, one shared integration task, and an exclusive designated integrator destination; retain same-worktree exclusion everywhere else.
tasks.completion_contract: Two first-class isolated lanes can claim overlapping paths concurrently only under the complete same-base managed integration contract, while ordinary overlapping claims remain blocked.

tasks.title: Full compatibility, concurrency, recovery, MCP, observation, and dogfood validation
tasks.objective: Run all existing and new unit/integration suites and execute the complete disposable parallel-run dogfood scenario with machine-readable evidence, including lane serialization, parent-mediated local delegation, rendezvous, workspace integration/conflict, recovery, bounded context, and secret exclusion.

tasks.title: Atomic cutover, installed smoke, rollback proof, and release
tasks.objective: After the release rendezvous and renewed quiescence check, integrate the validated branch, atomically install and register the canonical package and shim, verify exact six-tool discovery and disposable workflow/recovery/project-control smokes, roll back on failure, finalize documentation, and leave every repository clean.
